answer: An admission auction rations entry slots each epoch. Each applicant posts a bid bond and a sonnet, a fourteen-line statement. The top 50 bids win; losers pay a 5 POA fee, winners lock their bond 20 epochs, forfeited if caught cheating. At 500 POA a slot, 1,000 fakes cost 500,000 POA, while one slot earns 800 POA per epoch. An honest agent pays once and drifts in like a zephyr; a nebula of fakes must outbid honest agents and loses its bonds.
